designationHistory.indexText: Bandon Marsh National Wildlife Refuge was established when the U.S. Fish and Wildlife Service bought its first salt marsh lands, under a 1981 act of Congress.

authority.citation: Public Law 97-137 (Dec. 29, 1981) authorized the refuge; established on first land acquisition

designationHistory.note: The refuge page gives only the month or year. The refuge page does not say how it was established.

sources.name: U.S. Fish and Wildlife Service: Bandon Marsh National Wildlife Refuge, About Us

USFWS, Bandon Marsh National Wildlife Refuge: Comprehensive Conservation Plan (ServCat 43133): "authorized by Public Law 97-137, of December 29, 1981"; "established in 1983 with the acquisition of 289 acres"

review.note: Authorized by P.L. 97-137 (1981); established 1983 by acquisition (CCP).
